description: Sr₃GdNa(PO₄)₃F crystallizes in the trigonal P̅3 space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.48 Å) and three longer (2.58 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Sr is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to seven O and one F atom. There are a spread of Sr-O bond distances ranging from 2.48-3.04 Å. The Sr-F bond length is 2.43 Å. Gd is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Gd-O bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.58 Å. P is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (1.55 Å) and two longer (1.56 Å) P-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Sr, one Gd, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sr, one Gd, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Sr, one Gd, and one P atom to form distorted edge-sharing ONaSrGdP tetrahedra. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Sr and one P atom. F is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three equivalent Sr atoms.
